### Load packages and data

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) 
```

### Exercises 16-17


```{r setup-tibble}
team_data <- tibble(
  name = c("Pari", "Lizzy", "Ilayda", 
           "Bella", "Serena", "Joyce"),
  github_username = c("ps-18-6", "lizzyg888", "ilayda639", 
                      "isabella-lam", "serenat-0729","yuening"), 
  colour = c("pink", "purple", "navy", 
             "pink", "blue","yellow"),
  hobby = c("watching TV", "gaming", "reading", 
            "piano", "drawing","dancing"),
  favourite_number = c(9, 2, 7, 5, 2, 8)
  )

team_data
```

### Exercise 18


```{r bar-plot}
p1 <- ggplot(data = team_data, 
             mapping = aes(x = github_username, 
                           y = favourite_number,
                           fill = colour), 
             ) +
   geom_col() +
   scale_fill_identity()
p1
```
